title: 第十九章 凶宅第二十章 薇奥拉迪迪埃
slug: 开局a级禁物玩家给我打工

杀掉马迪男爵后，尤里安从马迪庄园“借”了一辆马车回家拉上了家里人，踏上了去往国都的旅程。
几人花费了四五天的时间来到了国都。
赶到国都的林奇几人并没有歇息，而是直接来到了国都的帕克图蒙迪商会。
到了商会门口，刚下车的林奇就看见一个球状的男人朝着自己飞奔而来。
“伊萨里斯少爷，您也来国都了啊。”因为太过着急而满头大汗的林克紧紧握住了林奇的手。
“林克？你怎么来国都了？”来人居然是吻痕镇帕克图蒙迪商会的林克。
“嘿嘿，这都是托了您的福，您变卖的罗兰家产都被算在了我的业绩上，商会看我的业绩优秀便将我从吻痕镇调来了国都，还给我升了职。
伊萨里斯少爷，我升了职之后权限提升了不少，您放心，我肯定能给您最低价。”林克的眼睛里透露着精明。
林克可知道罗兰家族的家产卖出了一个天文数字，伊萨里斯少爷来到了国都是不是得先找个落脚的地方？
手握巨款的贵族少爷难道还能买茅草屋吗？
“行，给我推荐一个庄园吧。”林奇知道林克的想法，无非就是感觉自己人傻钱多，但他也不在意，金钱对于林奇来说只是一个数字，实力才是一切的根本。
林克将林奇几人带到了贵宾室并且亲自泡了一壶红茶。
“伊萨里斯少爷，您先看看您有没有心仪的庄园。”林克递给了林奇一本大约二十厘米厚的相册。
打开后里面全都是精美的庄园照片。
林奇大概看了一看选了三套面积不大不小的庄园让林克着重介绍一下。
“伊萨里斯少爷，您的眼光真好，一眼就挑中了这里面最好的三个庄园，这个进口处有个小亭的庄园原本是特拉家族的庄园，后来他们搬去了卡尔蒙特镇，这个庄园面积大约十公顷，里面包括了一个主楼......”
林奇的注意力基本都放在了他最后一个选中的庄园上，当林奇看到这个庄园照片的第一眼就感觉眼熟，这好像是上一世一个很有人气的boss的领地。虽然看着像但林奇也不能确定，还是先听听林克的介绍。
“...这最后一个庄园嘛...说实话伊萨里斯少爷，我并不建议你选择它，虽然它是这三个庄园里面积最大、装修最豪华、价格最便宜的，但它......”林奇欲言又止。
“直说就行。”

“林克我虽然喜欢赚钱，但可不想害人性命，尤其伊萨里斯少爷您还是我的贵人，这个庄园它......是个凶宅啊。”
“哦？细说凶宅。”如果说之前还不太确定，凶宅这两个字一出来林奇基本上就确定了。
这就是上一世的boss，织梦者——薇奥拉·迪迪埃所在的迪迪埃庄园！
“这个庄园的名字叫迪迪埃庄园，迪迪埃家族原本是国都的贵族，但不知道为何全家在一夜之间都在睡梦中死去了，后来在法拍时这间庄园被一个商人拍走，结果第二天这个商人也死在了梦里...后续这个庄园换了大概四个主人，其中还有两个主人是序列8的强者，但他们都死了！”
林克的声音带着恐惧，仿佛害怕这个庄园会连他的性命也取走。
薇奥拉·迪迪埃，原本为迪迪埃家族最受宠的小女儿，长相美丽、性格温柔、天赋异禀的她还是一名序列9的牧树人。
在薇奥拉十三岁时她的姐姐送给了她一个八音盒，那个外表像是水晶球的八音盒实际上却是一个十分危险的a级禁物！
越是强大的禁物越是会寻找主人。
在其他人手中这只是一个会让持有者加速衰老的d级禁物，薇奥拉的姐姐嫉妒妹妹的美貌从黑市上买了下来送给了她，原本是想加速妹妹的衰老让她变丑，却引发了一场悲剧。

After killing Baron Madi, Julian "borrowed" a carriage from Madi Manor to go home, picked up his family, and embarked on a journey to the capital.
It took several people four or five days to reach the capital.
Lin Qi and others who rushed to the capital did not rest, but went directly to the Paktumundi Chamber of Commerce in the capital.
Arriving at the entrance of the Chamber of Commerce, Lynch, who had just gotten out of the car, saw a spherical man running towards him.
"Master Isharis, you have come to the capital too." Link, who was sweating profusely because he was too anxious, held Lin Qi's hand tightly.
"Link? Why are you here in the capital?" The visitor turned out to be Link from the Paktumundi Chamber of Commerce in Hickey Town.
"Hehe, this is all thanks to you. The Roland family property you sold was all counted towards my performance. Seeing my outstanding performance, the Chamber of Commerce transferred me from Kiss Town to the Capital and gave me a promotion.
Master Isharis, my authority has increased a lot after my promotion. Don’t worry, I will definitely give you the lowest price. "Link's eyes revealed shrewdness.
Does Link know that the Roland family's property has been sold for an astronomical amount? Does Young Master Isharis have to find a place to stay when he comes to the capital?
Can an aristocratic young man with a huge sum of money still buy a thatched house?
"Okay, recommend me a manor." Lin Qi knew what Link was thinking. He just felt that he was stupid and had too much money, but he didn't care. Money was just a number to Lin Qi, and strength was the root of everything.
Link took Lynch and others to the VIP room and made a pot of black tea himself.
"Master Isharis, please first see if you have a manor you like." Link handed Lynch a photo album about 20 centimeters thick.
When opened, it is filled with beautiful photos of the manor.
Lynch took a quick look and selected three manor houses, both large and small, for Link to highlight.
"Master Isharis, you have such a good eye. You have selected the three best manors here at a glance. This manor with a small pavilion at the entrance was originally the manor of the Terra family. Later they moved to Carlmont Town. This manor covers an area of about ten hectares and includes a main building..."
Lynch's attention was basically focused on the last manor he selected. When Lynch saw the photo of this manor, he felt familiar at first glance. It seemed to be the territory of a very popular boss in the previous life. Although it looked similar, Lynch wasn't sure, so he had to listen to Link's introduction first.
"...This last manor... To be honest, Master Isharis, I don't recommend you to choose it. Although it is the largest, most luxuriously decorated, and cheapest among the three manors, it..." Lynch stopped talking.
"Just say it."
"Although I like to make money, Link, I don't want to kill anyone, especially Master Isharis, you are still my nobleman. This manor... is a haunted house."
"Oh? Tell me more about the haunted house." If he was not sure before, Lynch was basically sure as soon as the word "haunted house" came out.
This is the Didier Manor where the boss in the previous life, the Dream Weaver, Viola Didier, lives!
"The name of this manor is Manor Didier. The Didier family was originally a noble of the capital, but for some reason the whole family died in their sleep overnight. Later, the manor was auctioned off by a businessman during the foreclosure. As a result, the businessman also died in his sleep the next day... Subsequently, this manor changed about four owners, and two of them were strong men from Sequence 8, but they all died!"
Link's voice was filled with fear, as if he was afraid that this manor would take his life as well.
Viola Didier was originally the most favored daughter of the Didier family. She was beautiful, gentle, and extremely talented. She was also a Sequence 9 tree shepherd.
When Viola was thirteen herHer sister gave her a music box. The music box looked like a crystal ball but was actually a very dangerous Class A forbidden object!
The more powerful the forbidden object is, the more it will look for its owner.
In the hands of others, this is just a D-level forbidden item that will accelerate the aging of the holder. Viola's sister was jealous of her sister's beauty and bought it on the black market and gave it to her. The original intention was to accelerate her sister's aging and make her look ugly, but it caused a tragedy.
